raw_snippet: Ohio-based Summa Health and General Catalyst’s Health Assurance Transformation Company (HATCo) today announced the completion of their transaction
value_text: acquired Summa Health (non-profit hospital system (converted to for-profit), USA)
note: Completion of HATCo's purchase of Summa Health; price $515m per Healthcare Dive and Ideastream (agreed at $485m, raised at the Ohio AG's request). Stated price about $515m.
